newsitem.title: FINLAND: HK-RUOKATALO AIMS AT HIGHER 1997 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: HK-RUOKATALO AIMS AT HIGHER 1997 PROFIT.

text.p: Finnish food group HK-Ruokatalo Oy said on Wednesday its aim was to make a better profit in 1997 than last year's 29.6 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
"Our aim is to reach a better result than last year," HK-Ruokatalo said in its 1996 profit and loss statement.
Domestic demand for its products would increase by about two percent this year, HK-Ruokatalo said, adding it expected its own market share to remain unchanged or increase slightly.
Last year, profitability was unsatisfactory early in the year but "improved clearly" towards the end, it said.
